text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Registration photo 2-inch recent colored photo. * 2. A valid ordinary passport, expiring after February 28, 2027. * 3. Police Certificate(within 6 months) * 4. English language proficiency Certificate for students whose native language is not English * 5. Copy of your notarized high school diploma Prospective students must submit official proof of student status by their current school. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. Please take the original copy of your current highest diploma with you for registration. * 6. Copy of your high school academic transcripts Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.) or UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT result. * 7. Certificate of Your Mother's Nationality(ID card or passport) * 8. Certificate of Your Father's Nationality(ID card or passport) * 9. Physical examination record for foreigner Complete it in Chinese or English, The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Study Plan Written in the language of instruction of the program, no less than 1,000 words. * 11. International Student Mental Health Questionnaire https://forms.gle/HRm2CNcmPzxbTfCj6 Please finish the test and submit the screenshot when you finish the test. 12. Other supporting documents Paper published, volunteering certificates, etc. * 13. Bank Statement To prove that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation, living expenses and international travels during his or her study in China. Only applicant himself/herself or his/her family can act as a financial sponsor. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 15. A statement of no drug addiction history You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
